description: Every adult-only label is Explicit, also spelt with a space (kid-hold-12 / grown-up-hold-12, #1128; docs/adr/0028-rating-tiers.md, addendum 2026-11-23 (6)): a delta on kid-hold-11.json, which a kid-hold-12 port must still pass except the superseded rows named below, and on every earlier file as kid-hold-11.json says. Written by hand from the ADR text, not computed with an independent reference. (1) TH 19 (also 19+) is level 7 and Explicit, like JP, KR, SG R21 and AU R: every adult-only label is level 7. (2) A rating of two letters, a space and the rest (SG R21, AU R, KR 19, JP 20, TH 19, NZ AO, ES X, GB R18) is Explicit when the same rating with a hyphen in place of that space (SG-R21, AU-R) is Explicit; the level of the spaced spelling is unchanged, so it stays unknown (null) and fails every ceiling, and a spaced spelling that is not adult-only (AU PG, TV MA, US R) is not Explicit. Stricter only: nothing Explicit in an earlier file stops being Explicit. SUPERSEDED rows of kid-hold-10.json (TH-19 and TH-19+) and kid-hold-11.json (TH-19): ratingMap TH-19 and TH-19+ are level 7 (were 6), and explicitRating rows for them are true.
